correctness.rationale: Every nonzero singular 2x2 matrix has rank 1; there are q+1 image lines I, q+1 kernel lines K, and q-1 nonzero maps of each type T_{I,K}. AB=0 iff im(B)=ker(A), giving complete adjacency between distinct types when J=K or L=I; diagonal type T_{I,I} is a clique, offdiagonal type independent. Two white vertices of the same true/false twin type cannot be individually forced; q=2 types are singleton. Encode remaining white types as edges of a bipartite graph on two copies of P^1(Fq). Each legal force deletes a degree-1 edge; a fully reducible edge set is acyclic. A spanning tree with 2q+1 edges has every row/column occupied, so no blue source with a singleton union of incident row and column can make an initial force (such a union of size 1 would imply an isolated K2 component). Thus at most 2q whites; source's explicit two-star-like 2q white edge set has a legal force sequence including q=2 blue-source boundary. Independent enumeration of all image/kernel type patterns for q=2 and q=3 confirms maxima 4 and 6 and counts, while proof holds for all prime powers.
